added.title: Café Restaurant Amsterdam
added.description: Big, lively brasserie in a 1900 water-pumping hall, serving all-day classics and seafood platters.

added.title: BAK
added.description: Seasonal, local tasting menu on the third floor of a harbour warehouse looking out over the IJ.

added.title: Hotel de Goudfazant
added.description: Not a hotel: a French-leaning three-course menu served in a vast old warehouse by the IJ.

added.title: Troef
added.description: Neo-bistro in an old workshop, with refined French-leaning plates and a very deep wine list.

added.title: Restaurant Blauw
added.description: Modern Indonesian known for its rijsttafel, a long spread of small dishes, including a vegan one.

added.title: Choux
added.description: Vegetable-led tasting menus with house ferments, in an old industrial building by the IJ.

added.title: Alba
added.description: Relaxed natural-wine spot with a rotating set menu of bold, creative plates, also served à la carte.

added.title: Helling 7
added.description: Open-fire cooking in a rebuilt shipyard hall at NDSM, with a terrace on the IJ and a veg chef's menu.

added.title: Vinkeles
added.description: Two-star French cooking with rich, layered sauces, in the old bakery of an 18th-century canal-side almshouse.

added.title: Bougainville
added.description: Intimate fine-dining room over Dam Square, mixing French technique with Asian and Middle Eastern spice.

added.title: MOS
added.description: Creative French-leaning tasting menus, with a full vegetarian version, at the tip of the IJdok over the water.

added.title: Lars Amsterdam
added.description: French technique with Asian accents by the harbour, plus a plant-based menu grown in its own rooftop garden.

added.title: Restaurant Europa
added.description: Inventive, seafood-leaning tasting menu served along a 25-metre counter facing the open kitchen.

added.title: Toscanini
added.description: Jordaan stalwart since 1985 for regional Italian cooking, fresh pasta and house-baked bread.

added.title: Wilde Zwijnen
added.description: Modern Dutch cooking from seasonal, regional produce, with a vegetarian set menu, on Javaplein.

added.title: Barracuda
added.description: Unfussy fish canteen in an old Noord workshop: tick off shared plates of the day's catch and shellfish.

added.title: Café Parlotte
added.description: Cosy corner wine bistro with a weekly-changing three-course menu and a long, French-leaning wine list.

added.title: Thai Thai Poppetje
added.description: Lively Thai street-food bar known for khao soi and Isaan salads, with tofu or jackfruit swaps on most dishes.

added.title: Café de Klepel
added.description: Snug French wine café with a daily three- or four-course bistro menu and more than 300 French bottles.

added.title: Roest
added.description: Big industrial hall on Oostenburg with fire-cooked bistro dishes, a summer terrace and DJs on Fridays.

added.title: REM
added.description: Restaurant and rooftop bar on a former pirate-radio sea platform, with chef's menus over the IJ.

added.title: Wijmpje Beukers
added.description: Relaxed eetcafé with a short seasonal menu, serious cocktails and tables kept free for walk-ins.

added.title: Scheepskameel
added.description: Straightforward Dutch cooking and a huge wine list in an old naval-yard building on Kattenburg.

added.title: Gitane
added.description: All-day neighbourhood café-restaurant: brunch, then Mediterranean-leaning plates and natural wines.

added.title: Bridges
added.description: Polished fish-focused restaurant in Sofitel The Grand, with French tasting menus and a vegetable menu.

added.title: Vermeer
added.description: Intimate hotel dining room serving French-rooted sharing plates built on Dutch produce.

added.title: Daalder
added.description: Dennis Huwaë's refined six-course dinner, back in its original corner spot on the Lindengracht.

added.title: Kaagman & Kortekaas
added.description: Lively open-kitchen restaurant with a seasonal set menu built around game, fish and wild greens.

added.title: Gebr. Hartering
added.description: Busy brothers-run bistro serving a daily-changing table d'hôte menu from small local suppliers.

added.title: Rijsel
added.description: Bustling French-Flemish bistro in a former domestic-science school, at fair prices.

added.title: VanOost
added.description: Fine dining in a lofty 1908 university building, blending French technique with Japanese flavours.

added.title: De Mark
added.description: Wood-fired, vegetable-led seasonal cooking in a dike-side hotel in Durgerdam village.

added.title: Gertrude
added.description: Oud-West bistro of seasonal sharing plates. Get the hamachi and the shrimp and bone-marrow dumpling.

added.title: Trees
added.description: Zeedijk bistro with a cocktail bar below. Order oysters, steak tartare or sole meunière, then go downstairs for a drink.

added.title: Ikkoku
added.description: Counter omakase cooked over an irori fire, hidden behind a matcha bar. Bluefin tuna or A5 wagyu courses.

added.title: Sjefietshe
added.description: Small corner ceviche bar in De Pijp. Order a few ceviches, the tuna tataki and the octopus roll.

added.title: De Japanner
added.description: Late-night izakaya on the Albert Cuyp. Share gyoza, bao, crispy rice and beef tataki.

added.title: Singel 404
added.description: Small canal-side lunch café, here since 1996. Order the tuna melt on sourdough or the Singel club.

added.title: Brasserie Zuiderbad
added.description: Simple café inside the 1912 Zuiderbad pool building near the Rijksmuseum. Sandwiches, bitterballen and fries.

added.title: Groot Melkhuis
added.description: Self-service park café by the water with a big playground. Get a baguette, the pea soup or the cheeseburger.

added.title: Café-Restaurant Hesp
added.description: Old brown café on the Amstel with a big terrace. Desembrood sandwiches at lunch, chicken saté or bavette at dinner.

added.title: Café de Schreierstoren
added.description: Café in the 15th-century city-wall tower by Centraal. Dutch pancakes, a croquette sandwich or chicken saté.

added.title: Landmarkt
added.description: Farm-shop restaurant in Schellingwoude using market produce. Eggs Benedict, the soup of the week or the swordfish Niçoise.

added.title: Tashi Deleg
added.description: Tibetan and Indonesian kitchen on the Utrechtsestraat. Order the rijsttafel or Tibetan momos.

added.title: Sampurna
added.description: Long-running Indonesian on the Singel by the Flower Market. Share a rijsttafel or try the goat saté and rendang.

added.title: Café Jakarta
added.description: Hotel restaurant at the tip of Java-eiland with IJ views. Order the Tafel Jakarta tasting or the beef rendang.

added.title: Blue Pepper
added.description: Modern Indonesian with a coursed rijsttafel. Go for 'The Sultan and I' menu or the beef rendang.

added.title: Waterkant
added.description: Busy Surinamese spot on the canal by the Marnixstraat garage. Chicken roti roll, heri heri or a bakkeljauw bun.

added.title: Roopram Roti
added.description: No-frills Surinamese roti shop in the Dapperbuurt. Get roti kip or roti lam.

added.title: Haven van Texel
added.description: Dutch eetcafé with a terrace on the canal at the Zeedijk end. Order the pea soup and the stamppot.

added.title: Café de Blaffende Vis
added.description: Brown café near the Noordermarkt since around 1916. Uitsmijter at lunch, chicken saté or the burger at dinner.

added.title: De Oceaan
added.description: Small harbourside eetcafé in the Eastern Docklands with a waterside terrace and SUP rental.

added.title: Captein & Co
added.description: Eetcafé on the Oudeschans with a canal terrace. Bitterballen to start, then chicken saté or trout.

added.title: Chez van Rijn
added.description: Parisian-style brasserie on Rembrandtplein with live jazz. Onion soup, then steak frites or coq au vin.

added.title: Spanjer en van Twist
added.description: Canal-side restobar on the Leliegracht now cooking Chilean food. Try the empanada, pastel de choclo or costillar.

added.title: Pension Homeland
added.description: Hotel, brewery and restaurant in the old officers' mess on the Marineterrein. Crab bisque, then steak with béarnaise.

added.title: Khorat Top Thai
added.description: Long-standing neighbourhood Thai near Vondelpark. Tom kha kai, fish cakes and a curry.

added.title: Ron Gastrobar
added.description: Ron Blaauw's lively starred gastrobar in Zuid with small and large plates. Order the beef Wellington and the boneless spareribs. Closing February 2027.

added.title: Siam Bowl
added.description: Thai street-food noodle bar with plastic stools. Order the khao soi, or tom yum noodles if you like it hot and sour.

added.title: Bird
added.description: Busy Chinatown Thai with a long menu, open since 1998. Go for a green or red curry and expect a short wait at the bar.

added.title: Songkran
added.description: Small family-run Thai with 28 wines. Try the Thai fish cakes and the chef's dorade specials.

added.title: Maenaam Thai
added.description: Simple, low-priced Thai near Spui. Order the pad thai or the massaman curry.

added.title: Warie's Thai Food
added.description: Small Thai with an open kitchen and a terrace, opposite the fire station. Order the green curry or pla sam rod.

added.title: Bangkok
added.description: Family-run Thai behind Tuschinski, open late. Start with the mixed starter, then pad thai or a curry.

added.title: Ocha
added.description: Tiny Thai room near Nieuwmarkt run by the same two cooks for years. Order the red curry with bamboo.

added.title: Boi Boi
added.description: Lao and Thai cooking by a chef who learned from his grandmother. Try the zin tod beef jerky and the laab.

added.title: Little Thai Prince
added.description: Small, plain Thai on the Zeedijk. Reviewers rate the tom yum soup, red curry and fried noodles.

added.title: Krua Buppha
added.description: Neighbourhood Thai on lower Van Woustraat with dishes that aren't too sweet. Book ahead, it fills up.

added.title: Cookkai
added.description: Tiny Thai snackbar and takeaway in the Jordaan since 2001. Order the keang karrie kai or the pad thai.

added.title: Kinnaree
added.description: Steady Jordaan Thai with a broad menu of soups, curries and wok dishes.

added.title: Krua Thai Classic
added.description: Family-run Thai near Waterlooplein since 1991, one of the city's first. Order the green curry or panang.

added.title: Sawaddee Ka
added.description: Thai on Overtoom with more than 100 dishes on the menu. Order a red curry or the house pad thai with beef.

added.title: Phu Thai
added.description: Isaan family cooking, mostly takeaway with a few tables. Order the beef laab or the beef noodle soup.

added.title: Royal Thai
added.description: Long-running Thai off Leidseplein, open late, with its own vegetarian starters and mains.

added.title: Baibua
added.description: Small family-run Thai eethuis off Vijzelstraat. Try the green papaya salad and the curries.

added.title: Rakang
added.description: Bangkok-style dishes for sharing in the Jordaan since 1994. Order a few plates, like panang beef and chicken in pandan leaf.
